mapping.summary: Syncs orders, products, stock, prices and customers between WooCommerce stores and BC.
claims: Two-way sync of orders, refunds, customers, items, variants, categories, attributes, stock, images, prices and coupons
Multiple WooCommerce stores can feed one BC company, each with separate mappings
Web orders arrive as BC sales orders with tax, shipping, fees, coupons and notes
Fulfilment and status are sent back to WooCommerce when posting
Orders created in BC are pushed to WooCommerce
Refunds are imported as return orders
Matches customers and items by ID, email or SKU and creates missing records from templates
Choose which items are published to each store
Sync runs on a schedule through BC job queue entries
Orders can be posted immediately, released or scheduled, with status filters
Sync logs with per-record errors and automatic retries
Optional modules for image sync, metadata, variants as items, customer-specific B2B pricing and multilingual catalogs
Includes a companion WordPress plugin and events for partner extensions
Free in sandboxes, 15-day trial in production
Paid tiers by monthly synced orders and refunds, from $60 to $250 per month
Works with Essentials and Premium editions
